data.name: RulesIntro
data.value: Each rule sends the links of a domain (and optionally a path) to a browser or web app.

data.name: RulesPattern
data.value: Domain or path (e.g. github.com or github.com/myorg)

data.name: BrowsersIntro
data.value: The default browser opens links that match no rule. The fallback browser is used if config.json is missing or damaged.

data.name: AppsIntro
data.value: Open links for these apps in their desktop app instead of the browser. Your rules take priority.

data.name: SettingsStripDescription
data.value: utm_*, fbclid, gclid, si and other campaign and social media identifiers.

data.name: SettingsExtraDescription
data.value: One per line. Added to the built-in list.

data.name: SettingsRegistered
data.value: Registered. In the Windows Settings page that just opened, find Switchman and click "Set default".

data.name: SettingsUnregistered
data.value: Switchman is no longer registered as a browser

data.name: SettingsIsDefault
data.value: Switchman is the default browser: links go through your rules.

data.name: SettingsNotDefault
data.value: Switchman is not the default browser. Click "Register as default" and choose it in Windows Settings.

data.name: TestIntro
data.value: Shows which browser would open the link and what it looks like without tracking parameters. Nothing is opened.

data.name: SaveReloaded
data.value: config.json was reloaded; your changes were not saved

data.name: ConflictBody
data.value: Reload discards your changes. Overwrite saves your version on top (if the file was damaged, a .bak copy is kept).

data.name: CliTimeout
data.value: switchman did not respond in time

data.name: DlIntro
data.value: A deep link opens the links of some domains in a desktop app instead of the browser. Example: with protocol steam, domain store.steampowered.com and template steam://openurl/{url}, the Steam store opens in Steam.

data.name: DlAppPlaceholder
data.value: Pick one or type it, e.g. steam

data.name: DlTemplateHelp
data.value: {url} the whole link · {host} domain · {path} path · {query} what follows the ?

data.name: DlNameInvalid
data.value: Give it a name (up to 64 characters).

data.name: DlSchemeInvalid
data.value: Use the protocol name only, lowercase, without :// (e.g. steam). http, https and file are not allowed.

data.name: DlTemplateTooLong
data.value: The template is too long (up to 512 characters).

data.name: DlDomainPath
data.value: Domains only, without a path: store.steampowered.com, not store.steampowered.com/app.

data.name: DlDomainInvalid
data.value: One of the domains is not valid.

data.name: DlExampleInvalid
data.value: Type a link that starts with https://

data.name: DlExampleNoMatch
data.value: This link is not from the domains above: Switchman would not send it to the app.

data.name: DlNotInstalled
data.value: No app on this PC handles {0}: the deep link will not be used until one is installed.

data.name: RedirectsIntro
data.value: A redirect opens a link as another one, before your rules. Useful for pages that don't make sense on a computer, such as "download our app" pages. The destination can be another link (https://…) or an app (whatsapp://).

data.name: RedirectsFrom
data.value: Link to catch (domain and optional path, e.g. reddit.com/mobile/download)

data.name: RedirectsFromHelp
data.value: Like a rule, it includes subdomains and everything under the path. End with / and no path (www.whatsapp.com/) to catch only the home page.

data.name: RedirectsTo
data.value: Open as (https://… link or app, e.g. https://www.reddit.com/ or whatsapp://)
